s5.title: Photo listed on The Blue Alliance

cycle.text: Two ways to score: the extending arm reaches mid and high nodes, and a separate cube shooter shoots cubes. One button homes the arm inside the frame after scoring.
For one full-grid match at the Mid-Atlantic championship, a post from its alliance gives 3314 ten pieces, mostly mid and high, starting from the bump side.

changed.text: The cube shooter shown is a second version, with bottom rollers added so cubes leave straighter and more predictably. The cube intake was the most damaged part and was repaired once during a competition.

outcome.text: 67-20-2 in official play; ranked 16 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 71.11, Daly).

functions.name: Arm

solves.text: Reach mid and high nodes and return inside the frame

functions.type: rotating arm extended by a lead screw

facts.text: A Falcon at the back of the arm turns the lead screw
A chain, gearbox and Falcon rotate it
Separate presets for mid and high nodes, and one button to home
The students report no structural damage to it

functions.name: Cone manipulator

solves.text: Grip a cone well and hold it at one known angle

functions.type: six rubber wheels at the arm's end

facts.text: The wheels draw the cone in to a fixed angle that suits scoring at any level
Running all six wheels outward scores the piece

functions.name: Cube shooter

solves.text: Intake cubes and shoot them predictably

functions.type: two-motor roller cube intake and shooter

facts.text: Two Falcons drive the top and bottom rollers separately
Bottom rollers were added in the second version for a straighter shot
Separate pairs of pneumatics bring it back and bring it up
It goes back up by itself once it detects a cube

cost.text: The team's most damaged part, built to be easy to repair

functions.name: Cube sensors

solves.text: Know whether a cube is held and where it sits

functions.type: three sensors that locate the cube

facts.text: One says a cube is inside; the other two say which side, and neither means it is centered

functions.name: LED signals

solves.text: Show a held piece that is hard to see

functions.type: LEDs for driver and human player

facts.text: Lights tell the driver a piece is held
Purple and yellow tell the human player which piece to feed

decisions.choice: Bottom rollers on the cube shooter
decisions.because: they make shots more stable, straight and predictable
decisions.instead_of: the first version without bottom rollers
